vb_textbox.text: where possible I would try and select a gnome with the same coloured hat as the previously shown basket - or the colour a closest match to the basket. When in doubt i'd opt for the gnome with the shorter hat. It may be worth experimenting to see if the nose position on the gnome affects the mushroom count - some gnomes have a nose that touches their hat, some don't. I found the gnomes with a nose not touching their hat often gave more mushrooms - but this may be linked with another factor.
